createScreen.noDeviceDetail: Start the desktop Agent on your computer, or scan to bind an existing device.

createScreen.modelPlaceholder: Leave empty to inherit user default{{suffix}}

createScreen.effortHintCodex: Codex reasoning effort: codex uses xhigh; leave empty to inherit the user default.
createScreen.effortHintOpencode: OpenCode models use provider/model; leave empty to inherit the user default.
createScreen.effortHintClaude: Claude reasoning effort: claude uses max; leave empty to inherit the user default.

sessionSettings.title: Session settings
sessionSettings.subtitle: MODEL / EFFORT
sessionSettings.empty: Session doesn't exist or has ended.
sessionSettings.modelPlaceholder: Leave empty to inherit the user default model
sessionSettings.modelHint: Specifying a model name overrides it for this session; leave empty to inherit the user default from Me.
sessionSettings.effortHint: EFFORT is sent as a separate field; the gateway sets reasoning effort from it ({{provider}} levels: {{levels}}). Selecting "Default" inherits the user default. Independent of the model — no need to pick a model first.
sessionSettings.timingDetail: Changes apply on your next sent message; the currently running turn keeps the original config — no need to restart the session.

deviceControl.deleteConfirmBody: This will permanently delete the device and all its projects / sessions / approvals. This cannot be undone.

toolsMenu.subtitle: {{agent}} · {{count}} commands

sessionCard.deleteFailed: Delete failed — the device may be offline, please retry.
sessionCard.copiedId: Copied session ID — open it in the terminal via `claude --resume <id>`.

composer.voiceError: Voice input failed, tap to retry

voiceInput.hint: Hold the mic to speak, release to end · or type directly

scrubber.hint: Drag the right rail to locate a conversation

loading.subtitle: LOADING
loading.detailTimeout: Full conversation fetch timed out; live messages will still appear.

phase.pendingStart: Not started · send a message to begin

error.interruptFailed: Stop failed, please check the server connection.

composer.claudeRunning: Claude Code is running; stop it to continue typing.

approval.pendingSyncHint: An approval event was detected; the full action data is still syncing. Pull to refresh and resolve it here, or open Approvals from the home screen.
approval.fallbackSummary: The assistant is waiting for approval.

quickPolicy.title: Quick approval mode
quickPolicy.subtitle: Switch this project's approval policy
quickPolicy.customOtherNote: Current mode is a custom policy not matching any preset above.

allowAll.title: Approve everything
allowAll.hint: All future approvals auto-pass, including destructive commands and unknown tools. Current one is also approved.

commonAuto.title: Approve common tools
commonAuto.hint: MCP, file edits, reads and common bash auto-pass; only catastrophic commands (rm -rf, sudo, git push…) still ask. Current one is also approved.

balanced.title: Ask each time
balanced.hint: Restore the default balanced policy — each approval prompts you again.

mcpTier.title: Approve {{label}}
mcpTier.hint: Auto-approve this MCP server's tools from now on. Current one is also approved.

mcpAll.title: Approve all MCP tools
mcpAll.hint: Auto-approve every MCP server tools (mcp__*). Current one is also approved.

quickPolicy.mcpApplyFailed: Couldn't save the MCP auto-approve rule. Try again.

offline.title: Device offline · read-only
offline.detail: This device is unreachable. Send / approve / control are paused, but you can still browse history.

empty.offlineTitle: Desktop Agent offline — can't sync history
empty.offlineDetail: The full history for this conversation lives on the desktop Agent and can only be fetched when it's online. Make sure the Agent is running and connected, then pull to refresh.
empty.failedDetail: Something went wrong fetching history from the desktop Agent — possibly a network blip or a data-format issue. Pull to refresh; if it keeps failing, try again later.
empty.summaryDetail: The backend has synced this VibeCoding's title, status, or message count, but no viewable message bodies yet. Once the Agent is online and supports history detail, pull to refresh to fill them in.
empty.blankDetail: This conversation has no messages yet. Pull to sync history; if it's new, send a message below to start.
